summary_1line: Introduces Paushya Parva: Janamejaya is cursed by Sarama, seeks a priest, and several stories illustrate extreme obedience and devotion to one's teacher.

image_candidates.scene_text: Aruni lies down in the breached irrigation channel, using his own body to stop the rushing water while the field floods around him.
Blind Upamanyu sits at the bottom of a dark well, praying to the twin Aswins as a faint divine light appears above.
The celestial dog Sarama confronts King Janamejaya at his sacrifice after her injured pup runs to her crying.
